text: The following codes govern, in this order for a conflict between them: (1) Turkish legislation (Zoning Law, Building Earthquake Code TBDY 2018, Fire Regulation); (2) the Employer's Requirements; (3) TBDY 2018 for seismic actions and seismic detailing; (4) EN 1990 with EN 1991 (actions), EN 1992 (concrete), EN 1993 (steel) with National Annexes; (5) TS 500 where cited above; (6) ACI 351.3R for dynamic equipment foundations; (7) ISO 20816-2 for vibration evaluation; (8) EN ISO 1461 and ISO 12944-2 for corrosion protection.
